title: avenula lodunensis subsp. albinervis
intro: Avenula lodunensis subsp. albinervis, commonly known as a subspecies of the mountain hair grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Avenula lodunensis subsp. albinervis include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit neuroprotective effects, making it a subject of interest in traditional herbal medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that are responsible for its medicinal properties.
